lemmas.def_en: a man who has never been married

examples.en: He remained a confirmed bachelor until his late forties.
examples.zh: 他直到近五十岁时依然是个坚定的单身汉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指未婚男子或学士学位获得者，常见搭配如 bachelor party（单身汉派对）或 bachelor's degree。

lemmas.def_en: the time of a man's life prior to marriage

examples.en: After enjoying years of bachelorhood, he finally decided to settle down and get married.
examples.zh: 在享受了多年的单身生活后，他终于决定安定下来结婚。

lemmas.def_en: lead a bachelor's existence

examples.en: While his wife was away on business, Mark had to bachelor it for two weeks.
examples.zh: 妻子出差期间，马克不得不自己过两周单身生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语表达，常与 it 连用（bachelor it），表示单身独居或过单身汉式生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语，原指年轻骑士侍从，后演变为“未婚单身汉”及大学最初级的学位“学士”。

lemmas.def_en: foreshadow or presage
lemmas.def_zh: 预示……的到来，宣布，公开称赞

examples.en: The discovery of antibiotics heralded a new era in modern medicine.
examples.zh: 抗生素的发现预示着现代医学新时代的到来。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语动词，指预告新事物到来或公开赞颂，常用于科技、社会变革等宏大语境。

lemmas.def_en: without warning or announcement; ; - M.A.D.Howe
lemmas.def_zh: （艺术家、运动员等）被埋没的, 怀才未遇的; 出乎意料的；毫无先兆的

examples.en: The unheralded young tennis player stunned everyone by defeating the reigning champion.
examples.zh: 那位默默无闻的年轻网球选手击败了卫冕冠军，震惊了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指中世纪宫廷发布告示或传达命令的传令官，引申为“预兆、宣告重大事件的到来”。

lemmas.def_en: make (one thing) compatible with (another)
lemmas.def_zh: 使和解, 调停, 使和谐, 使一致, 使听从

examples.en: The committee tried to reconcile the conflicting demands of both parties.
examples.zh: 委员会试图调和双方相互冲突的诉求。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 with，既可表示使两人或派系和解，也可表示使两种对立的观点、账目取得一致。

lemmas.def_en: the reestablishing of cordial relations
lemmas.def_zh: 和解, 和好, 复交, 调解, 调停, 和谐, 一致, 甘愿, 顺从

examples.en: The treaty marked the beginning of historical reconciliation between the two nations.
examples.zh: 该条约标志着两国历史性和解的开端。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式名词，常指争端后的和解或账目核对，常见搭配如 reach/achieve reconciliation。

lemmas.def_en: someone who tries to bring peace

examples.en: She acted as a patient reconciler between the two arguing business partners.
examples.zh: 她在两位发生争执的商业伙伴之间充当了耐心的调解人。

lemmas.def_en: not made consistent or compatible
lemmas.def_zh: 未和解的, 未取得一致的, 不顺从的

examples.en: The two former best friends remained unreconciled even years after their bitter argument.
examples.zh: 在这场激烈的争吵过去数年后，两位昔日好友仍未和解。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（再次）+ conciliare（召集、使联合），核心语义为“重新撮合、使两造重新恢复和谐”。
family_guide.core_distinction: reconcile 是动词；reconciliation 是其名词形式，强调和解的过程或结果。

lemmas.def_en: a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends

examples.en: The royal court was rife with political intrigue and secret alliances.
examples.zh: 宫廷里充斥着政治阴谋与秘密结盟。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指政治暗斗、密谋或扑朔迷离的复杂情节，多作不可数名词，也可指具体密谋。

lemmas.def_en: cause to be interested or curious
lemmas.def_zh: 密谋, 私通；激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得

examples.en: The mysterious painting immediately intrigued art historians around the world.
examples.zh: 这幅神秘的画作立即引起了全世界艺术史学家的兴趣。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词常表示激起极大兴趣，不及物动词常与 against 搭配表示暗中密谋算计。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 intricare（使纠缠），演变出暗中策划复杂阴谋，以及“激起强烈好奇心（被情节纠缠吸引）”之义。

lemmas.def_en: the habitation of wild animals
lemmas.def_zh: 兽穴；(家中舒适隐蔽的)私室，书房；窝点

examples.en: The bear retreated to its den to hibernate for the winter.
examples.zh: 熊退回到自己的洞穴中冬眠。

lemmas.usage_note: 除“兽穴”外，北美英语中常指家庭中供休闲放松的“小书房/私室”，另有贬义搭配 a den of thieves（贼窝）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 denn，原指野生动物的洞穴，引申为隐秘私人的小窝，或进行不法活动的贼窝。

lemmas.def_en: a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food
lemmas.def_zh: 匙, 调羹, 匙形工具

examples.en: She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 她用一把木勺搅拌着汤。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指餐具匙或匙状工具，常用于日常生活及测量单位（如 a spoon of）。

lemmas.def_en: as much as a spoon will hold

examples.en: Adding a spoonful of honey can soothe a sore throat quite effectively.
examples.zh: 加一勺蜂蜜能相当有效地缓解喉咙痛。

lemmas.def_en: scoop up or take up with a spoon
lemmas.def_zh: 以匙舀起, 调情, 使成匙状

examples.en: He spooned the leftover rice into a small plastic container.
examples.zh: 他用勺子把剩饭舀进一个小塑料盒里。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，常与 up、out 或 into 连用表示用勺舀取，口语中亦可指紧贴侧卧或调情。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为木片或刨花，后引申为舀取食物的勺状餐具及相应动作。

lemmas.def_en: be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance
lemmas.def_zh: 获胜, 流行, 盛行

examples.en: Justice will eventually prevail over corruption.
examples.zh: 正义终将战胜腐败。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与 over/against 连用表示战胜，或表示某种风气、观点在特定区域盛行。

lemmas.def_en: most frequent or common

examples.en: Deficiency in vitamin D is increasingly prevalent among office workers.
examples.zh: 维生素D缺乏在办公室职员中越来越普遍。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面形容词，指某种现象、疾病或观念普遍存在，常作表语或定语修饰社会问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍, 流行, 广泛
lemmas.def_en: the quality of prevailing generally; being widespread

examples.en: Researchers noticed a dramatic decline in the prevalence of smoking.
examples.zh: 研究人员注意到吸烟流行率出现了急剧下降。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与正式名词，多用于医学、统计学，指疾病患病率或某种社会现象的普及程度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praevalere（力量更强、占优），引申为战胜或普遍存在。

lemmas.def_en: all the plant life in a particular region or period

examples.en: The unique flora of this island has adapted to extreme volcanic conditions.
examples.zh: 该岛独特的植物群已适应了极端的火山环境。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，指某地区或时期的全部植物群，常与 fauna（动物群）成对使用。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or made of or suggestive of flowers
lemmas.def_zh: 花似的, 花的, 植物的

examples.en: She wore a light summer dress with a delicate floral pattern.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件带有精致花卉图案的轻薄夏裙。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰图案、气味或装饰，意为由花制成的、含花卉图案的或花香的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗马神话中的花神 Flora，专指某地区的全部植物群。
family_guide.core_distinction: flora指植物群整体（名词），floral指花朵的、花卉图案的（形容词）。

lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
lemmas.def_zh: 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额

examples.en: The national mint released a commemorative silver coin this morning.
examples.zh: 国家造币厂今天上午发行了一枚纪念银币。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指薄荷植物，也指法定造币厂；口语中 a mint 意为巨额财富，如 make a mint。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who coins or stamps money

examples.en: The royal minter carefully examined the newly produced gold coins for flaws.
examples.zh: 皇家铸币工仔细检查新铸的金币是否有瑕疵。

lemmas.def_en: coins collectively
lemmas.def_zh: 造币, 铸币材料, 创造

examples.en: Coins from that rare mintage are highly prized by collectors around the globe.
examples.zh: 那批罕见铸币时期的硬币深受全球收藏家的青睐。

lemmas.def_en: form by stamping, punching, or printing
lemmas.def_zh: 铸造, 铸币, 制造

examples.en: The government minted new banknotes to replace the damaged currency.
examples.zh: 政府铸印了新钞票以替换受损的旧货币。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指铸造硬币，引申为创造新词、新概念（如 mint a new term）或制造事物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 moneta（造币厂）及 mentha（薄荷），英语中同形异源，兼表造币与香草。

lemmas.def_en: cause to become detached or separated; take off

examples.en: Carefully detach the coupon along the dotted line before mailing.
examples.zh: 邮寄前请沿虚线仔细将优惠券撕下。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常搭配 from，指将某物从整体上分离拆卸，或指军事上派遣小分队。

lemmas.def_en: avoiding emotional involvement
lemmas.def_zh: 分离, 分遣, 分遣队

examples.en: He observed the chaotic scene with an unusual sense of calm detachment.
examples.zh: 他以一种不同寻常的冷静超然态度观察着混乱的场面。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 超然的；不带感情色彩的；独立客观的；分离的
lemmas.def_en: showing a lack of emotional involvement or bias; separate or not connected
lemmas.usage_note: 用于心态时指冷静、客观、置身事外（如 a detached observer）；用于房屋建筑时特指独立式住宅（detached house）。

examples.en: A good judge must remain detached and examine only the facts.
examples.zh: 优秀的法官必须保持客观超然，只审视事实。

family_guide.root_logic: 由否定前缀 de-（分离）与 attach（附着）的反向构词，核心在于“解除连接”。

lemmas.def_en: make understand
lemmas.def_zh: 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导

examples.en: Could you please enlighten me on the details of this proposal?
examples.zh: 能否请你就这份提案的细节对我作些说明？

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接人作宾语，常与 on 搭配，表示提供信息或知识以启迪、开导某人。

lemmas.def_en: education that results in understanding and the spread of knowledge

examples.en: Reading classical philosophy brought him deep spiritual enlightenment.
examples.zh: 阅读古典哲学带给他深刻的精神启迪。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常指智慧启迪或精神领悟；首字母大写特指欧洲历史上的“启蒙运动”。

lemmas.def_en: not enlightened; ignorant
lemmas.def_zh: 愚昧无知的, 未受启发的

examples.en: His unenlightened views on gender roles caused frequent arguments in modern society.
examples.zh: 他在性别角色方面愚昧落后的观点在现代社会引发了频繁争议。

family_guide.root_logic: en-（使...）+ light（光明）+ -en，字面意为“照亮心中未知”，即启发、启蒙。
family_guide.core_distinction: enlighten 为动词（启蒙），enlightenment 为其抽象名词（启迪、启蒙运动）。

lemmas.def_en: a movement back from an impact
lemmas.def_zh: 反弹, 返回, 篮板球, 振作

examples.en: He started dating someone immediately after the breakup, but it was just a rebound.
examples.zh: 分手后他立刻和别人交往了，但这只是一段寻求心理慰藉的过渡期恋情。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指经济好转、情感过渡期或篮球中的篮板球，常见搭配如 on the rebound、economic rebound。

lemmas.def_en: spring back; spring away from an impact
lemmas.def_zh: 弹回, 返回, 产生事与愿违的结果；使弹回, 使返回

examples.en: Property prices are expected to rebound gradually from the sharp downturn next year.
examples.zh: 预计房地产价格将在明年从急剧下滑中逐步回升。

lemmas.usage_note: 指物体弹回、指标回升或策略产生适得其反的恶果，常与 from 或 on 连用，多用于正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（向后、再次）+ bound（跳跃），核心表“弹回”及引申的“复苏”。

lemmas.def_en: any cone-shaped artifact

examples.en: The workers placed an orange cone in the middle of the road to divert traffic.
examples.zh: 工人们在路中央放置了一个橙色交通锥以分流车辆。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指几何圆锥体、松果，也指交通锥或冰淇淋甜筒，常搭配 traffic cone、pine cone 等具象名词。

lemmas.def_en: (geometry) a curve generated by the intersection of a plane and a circular cone

examples.en: The mathematician plotted the conic on the board to illustrate the geometry lesson.
examples.zh: 数学家在黑板上绘制了二次曲线来讲解几何课。

lemmas.def_en: deprive of by deceit
lemmas.def_zh: 精读, 仔细研究, 默记

examples.en: The scholar spent the whole afternoon conning the ancient manuscript line by line.
examples.zh: 那位学者花了一整个下午逐行精读那部古代手稿。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或书面语中指仔细研读、默记，现也常口语化指欺骗或诈骗，搭配 con sb out of money。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or resembling a cone

examples.en: The volcano had a classic conical shape rising majestically above the plains.
examples.zh: 这座火山呈现出典型的圆锥形，巍然耸立在平原之上。

lemmas.def_en: in a conical manner

examples.en: The glass was conically shaped to enhance the delicate aroma of the wine.
examples.zh: 这只酒杯呈圆锥形，旨在提升葡萄酒的细腻香气。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 konos，本义指圆锥形松果或几何圆锥体；动词 con 实为同形词（骗取），现代英语视同形处理。
family_guide.core_distinction: cone为名词（圆锥），con为动词（诱骗、诈骗）。

lemmas.def_en: an awkward and inexperienced youth

examples.en: The mother bear fiercely guarded her cub against potential predators in the forest.
examples.zh: 母熊在森林里凶猛地保护着自己的幼崽免遭潜在捕食者的侵害。

lemmas.usage_note: 指肉食性动物（如熊、狮、虎）的幼崽，亦可戏谑或轻蔑地指缺乏经验的年轻新手，如 cub reporter。

lemmas.def_en: give birth to cubs

examples.en: The female fox found a secluded den where she could safely cub in early spring.
examples.zh: 那只雌狐找到了一个隐蔽的巢穴，以便在早春安全地产仔。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指母兽产仔，常以不及物动词形式出现，属专业动物学或狩猎语境词汇，使用频率较低。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指年轻的野生肉食兽类幼崽，动词指（兽类）产仔。

lemmas.def_en: not clearly understood or expressed; ; -Anatole Broyard; - P.A.Sorokin; - John Locke
lemmas.def_zh: 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的

examples.en: The spokesperson gave a vague answer to avoid addressing the controversial policy directly.
examples.zh: 发言人给出了一个含糊其辞的回答，以避免直接谈论这项有争议的政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容记忆、言辞或轮廓不清晰、模棱两可，常用搭配包括 vague memory、vague answer、remain vague。

lemmas.def_en: in a vague way

examples.en: I vaguely remember meeting him at a conference several years ago in Chicago.
examples.zh: 我依稀记得几年前在芝加哥的一次会议上见过他。

lemmas.def_en: unclearness by virtue of being poorly expressed or not coherent in meaning

examples.en: The vagueness of the contract caused serious misunderstandings between the two companies later.
examples.zh: 合同条款的模糊性后来导致了两家公司之间的严重误解。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vagus（游荡、不固定），引申为思路不明确、界限模糊。

lemmas.def_en: of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing; - Curtis Wilkie

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its roast duck, which has a very distinctive smoky aroma.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆以烤鸭闻名，其烤鸭具有非常独特的烟熏香气。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示独具特色、易于识别的属性，褒义色彩居多，常修饰 flavor、style、feature、aroma 等。

lemmas.def_en: in an identifiably distinctive manner

examples.en: The soup had a distinctively spicy flavor that set it apart from normal broth.
examples.zh: 这种汤带有一种独特的辛辣风味，与普通的清汤截然不同。

lemmas.def_en: a distinguishing trait

examples.en: The distinctiveness of her design made the building stand out among the modern skyscrapers.
examples.zh: 她设计的独特性使这栋建筑在众多现代摩天大楼中脱颖而出。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 distinct（清晰的、与众不同的），后缀 -ive 强调具有某种独特性质或特征。

lemmas.def_en: an occurrence that involves the production of a union
lemmas.def_zh: 熔合物, 结合, 熔合

examples.en: The chef is celebrated for his creative fusion of traditional French and Japanese culinary arts.
examples.zh: 这位厨师因将传统法餐与日料烹饪艺术创造性地融合而备受赞誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指物理上的核聚变，也可指文化、菜系、音乐的跨界融合，如 nuclear fusion、fusion cuisine。

lemmas.def_en: mix together different elements

examples.en: The intense heat caused the metal components to fuse together into a solid lump.
examples.zh: 高温导致这些金属构件熔合在了一起，成为一块坚硬的固态整体。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示结合、熔化或（使保险丝）熔断，既可及物也可不及物，常与 with/into 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being melted and fused

examples.en: Lead is a easily fusible metal with a relatively low melting point.
examples.zh: 铅是一种容易熔化的金属，熔点相对较低。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fundere（熔化、浇注），指不同事物融合或物理上的核聚变。

lemmas.def_en: not firm or firmly fixed; likely to fail or give way
lemmas.def_zh: 不安全的, 不牢靠的, 不坚固的, 不稳定的

examples.en: Despite her outward success, she still felt deeply insecure about her academic abilities.
examples.zh: 尽管表面上很成功，她对自己的学术能力依然深感缺乏安全感。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指缺乏自信或安全感的心态，也可指物理上的不牢固或局势的不稳定，常与 about 连用。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being subject to danger or injury

examples.en: Job insecurity has become a major source of stress for employees in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 工作缺乏稳定性已成为科技行业员工的主要压力来源。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数表示不安全状态或社会动荡，可数形式表心理上的自卑或不安全感，如 deep insecurities。

lemmas.def_en: in a tentative and self-conscious manner

examples.en: The heavy painting was hung insecurely on the wall and fell down yesterday.
examples.zh: 那幅沉重的画没有牢固地挂在墙上，昨天掉落了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: in-（非）+ secure（安心的、稳固的），核心表缺乏安全感或物理上不稳定。
family_guide.core_distinction: insecure 为形容词，insecurity 为其状态名词（不安全感）。

lemmas.def_en: a hand with the fingers clenched in the palm (as for hitting)

examples.en: He clenched his fist tightly in frustration after hearing the disappointing news today.
examples.zh: 在听到今天令人失望的消息后，他沮丧地紧紧握起了拳头。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭 clench/make a fist（握拳），习惯表达 make a good fist of sth（口语，指把某事做得很出色）。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity that can be held in the hand
lemmas.def_zh: 一把, 相当大的数量

examples.en: The child grabbed a fistful of colorful candies from the jar on the counter.
examples.zh: 孩子从柜台上的罐子里抓了一把五颜六色的糖果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fyst，原始印欧语表手部紧握状态，专指握紧的拳头。

lemmas.def_en: a difficult or unusual or dangerous feat; usually done to gain attention
lemmas.def_zh: 特技, 绝技, 花招, 噱头, 手腕, 发育不良

examples.en: Faking an argument on stage was merely a publicity stunt designed to boost ticket sales.
examples.zh: 在舞台上伪造争吵纯粹是为了提高门票销量而搞的宣传噱头。

lemmas.usage_note: 指特技表演或吸引眼球的宣传噱头，常见搭配 publicity stunt、pull a stunt，口语中常带贬义。

lemmas.def_en: check the growth or development of

examples.en: Severe malnutrition during early childhood can permanently stunt a person's physical growth.
examples.zh: 童年早期的严重营养不良会永久性地阻碍一个人的身体发育。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词意为阻碍、遏制正常的成长、发育或进展，常搭配 stunt the growth/development of...

family_guide.root_logic: 作为名词源于杂耍特技；作为动词源于古英语意为矮小、阻碍生长，两者词源独立现同形。
family_guide.core_distinction: stunt作名词多指特技、噱头；作动词多指阻碍成长。

lemmas.def_en: a ceremonial dinner party for many people
lemmas.def_zh: 宴会, 酒席, 享受, 节日

examples.en: The documentary presents a visual feast of untouched landscapes and rare wildlife.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片呈现了一场原生态风貌与珍稀野生动物的视觉盛宴。

lemmas.usage_note: 指盛宴或感官盛宴，常与 for 连用，经典表达如 a feast for the eyes（视觉盛宴）、wedding feast。

lemmas.def_en: partake in a feast or banquet
lemmas.def_zh: 款待, 享乐, 请客；参加宴会, 尽情地吃, 享受

examples.en: After days of strict dieting, the athletes feasted on burgers and milkshakes after the game.
examples.zh: 经过数天的严格节食，运动员们在赛后尽情大吃汉堡和奶昔。

lemmas.usage_note: 意为尽情享用美食或让眼目享受，常用固定搭配 feast on sth 或 feast one's eyes on sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 festum（节日、盛宴），核心含义与欢聚、大吃大喝相关。

lemmas.def_en: kill without legal sanction
lemmas.def_zh: 处以私刑处死, 加私刑

examples.en: The angry mob attempted to break into the jail and lynch the suspected criminal.
examples.zh: 愤怒的暴民企图强行闯入监狱，将这名犯罪嫌疑人施以私刑处死。

lemmas.usage_note: 指未经合法审判而由暴民施以私刑致死，属于历史、法律及社会政治语境下的正式且沉重的词汇。

lemmas.def_en: putting a person to death by mob action without due process of law

examples.en: The museum exhibits rare photographs documenting the horrific history of lynching in the South.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了记录美国南部私刑处死暴行可怕历史的罕见照片。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词形式指非法处私刑杀人的行为或事件，多见于美国民权史相关文献，属严肃的历史与政论用语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美国林奇判决（Lynch law），指未经合法审判动用私刑处死。

lemmas.def_en: a large mass of land projecting into a body of water
lemmas.def_zh: 半岛, 突出的地方, 伊比利亚半岛

examples.en: The rugged peninsula extends far out into the icy waters of the North Sea.
examples.zh: 这座崎岖的半岛向外大幅延伸至北海冰冷的水域中。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指三面临水、一面与陆地相连的半岛，常用于地理描述或专有名词搭配中。

lemmas.def_en: of or forming or resembling a peninsula

examples.en: The army established a naval base along the strategic southern peninsular coast.
examples.zh: 军队在该半岛南部具有战略意义的海岸线上建立了海军基地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 paene（几乎）+ insula（岛），即几乎被水包围的“半岛”。

lemmas.def_en: obtain or seize by violence

examples.en: The starving wolves began to raven through the forest in desperate search of prey.
examples.zh: 饥饿的狼群开始在森林中四处劫掠，绝望地搜寻猎物。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面罕用动词，指饥饿地狼吞虎咽或掠夺，常接 raven for 搭配，现代英语更常用其派生形容词 ravenous。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 raviner（掠夺），与名词渡鸦（raven）不同源，表贪婪掠食。

lemmas.def_en: be in contradiction with
lemmas.def_zh: 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾；反驳

examples.en: Recent experimental data directly contradict the hypothesis proposed last year.
examples.zh: 最近的实验数据与去年提出的假说直接相抵触。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指反驳言论或事实相互抵触，常接 statement 或 oneself。

lemmas.def_en: opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas

examples.en: There is an obvious contradiction between what the politician promised and what he actually did.
examples.zh: 这位政客所承诺的与他的实际作为之间存在明显的矛盾。

lemmas.def_zh: 反驳的, 反对的, 抗辩的
lemmas.def_en: of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true and both cannot be false

examples.en: Witnesses provided contradictory accounts of how the accident actually occurred.
examples.zh: 目击者就事故究竟是如何发生的提供了相互矛盾的陈述。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示相互矛盾的、对立的，常搭配 advice, evidence 或 reports。

lemmas.def_zh: 反驳地, 逆, 矛盾地
lemmas.def_en: in a contradictory manner

examples.en: he argued contradictorily

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 contra（相反）+ dicere（说），字面即“唱反调、说反话”。

lemmas.def_en: being ten more than fifty

examples.en: The auditorium can comfortably seat sixty delegates for the plenary session.
examples.zh: 该礼堂可舒适地容纳六十位代表参加全体会议。

lemmas.usage_note: 数词作定语修饰名词，表示六十的、六十个的，直接置于可数名词复数前。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six

examples.en: She retired in her early sixties to spend more time travelling abroad.
examples.zh: 她在六十岁出头时退休，以便有更多时间去国外旅行。

lemmas.usage_note: 数词作名词，代指基数六十，或以 the sixties 形式表示年代或年龄段。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语数词，由 six（六）+ -ty（十的倍数后缀）构成。

lemmas.def_en: a definite length of time marked off by two instants
lemmas.def_zh: 间隔, 距离, 间歇, 间隙

examples.en: Trains arrive at regular intervals during the morning rush hour in the city.
examples.zh: 早高峰期间，市区的列车按固定时间间隔进站。

lemmas.usage_note: 高频搭配 at regular intervals（每隔一定时间/距离）；英式英语中常指戏剧幕间休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inter-（在……之间）+ vallum（城墙、栅栏），本指城墙间的空地，引申为间隔。

lemmas.def_en: a support that steadies or strengthens something else
lemmas.def_zh: 支柱, 曲柄, 支撑, 一对

examples.en: The doctor advised the teenager to wear a back brace to correct his spinal curve.
examples.zh: 医生建议这名青少年佩戴背部支架以矫正其脊柱侧弯。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指用于加固的支架、牙套或成双成对的人与物（复数仍为 brace）。

lemmas.def_en: a protective covering for the wrist or arm that is used in archery and fencing and other sports

examples.en: The archer strapped on a leather bracer to protect his forearm from injury.
examples.zh: 弓箭手系上皮质护臂以防前臂受伤。

lemmas.def_en: prepare (oneself) for something unpleasant or difficult
lemmas.def_zh: 紧缚, 支撑, 激励；打起精神

examples.en: Coastal residents were urged to brace themselves for the approaching hurricane.
examples.zh: 沿海居民被敦促做好准备以应对即将来临的飓风。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，常用于 brace oneself for 或 brace for sth，意为做好面对困难的准备或加固。

lemmas.def_en: undo the ties of
lemmas.def_zh: 解开, 使不紧张, 放松, 使衰弱, 使松弛

examples.en: After hours of intense work, he finally unbraced his shoulders and breathed deeply.
examples.zh: 经过数小时紧张工作，他终于放松了肩膀，深吸了一口气。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 brachia（双臂），引申出抱紧、支撑、加固的含义。

lemmas.def_en: engage in a rehearsal (of)
lemmas.def_zh: 预演, 排演, 使熟练掌握, 练习, 复述；排练, 练习, 演习

examples.en: The actors spent weeks rehearsing the final act before opening night.
examples.zh: 在首演之夜到来前，演员们花了数周时间排练最后一幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指排练戏剧、演说或详述事实，常用宾语为 speech 或 scene。

lemmas.def_en: a practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)
lemmas.def_zh: 预演, 排演, 练习, 叙述, 复述

examples.en: The director called an extra rehearsal to polish the choreography for the opening scene.
examples.zh: 导演追加了一次排练，以润色开场戏的舞蹈编排。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指演出前的排练、预演，高频搭配包括 dress rehearsal（彩排）和 in rehearsal。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 re-（再）+ hercier（耙地），原指反复耙地，引申为“反复排演、复述”。

lemmas.def_en: any of several complex proteins that are produced by cells and act as catalysts in specific biochemical reactions

examples.en: Certain digestive enzymes help break down complex proteins into simple amino acids.
examples.zh: 某些消化酶有助于将复合蛋白质分解为简单的氨基酸。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学名词，指促进生化反应的酶，常搭配 digestive enzyme 或 enzyme activity。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or produced by an enzyme

examples.en: The fruit turned brown rapidly due to an enzymatic reaction with the air.
examples.zh: 由于与空气发生酶促反应，水果迅速变黄褐色。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 en-（在……内）+ zyme（酵母），指生物体内的生化催化剂。

lemmas.def_en: any of various kinds of wheeled vehicles drawn by an animal or a tractor

examples.en: The wooden wagon rattled along the rocky path behind two strong horses.
examples.zh: 两匹骏马拉着木制马车在石子路上咯咯作响地前行。

lemmas.usage_note: 指四轮运货马车或货车车厢；高频成语 jump on the wagon / climb on the bandwagon 指顺应潮流。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 wagen（车辆），专指运载重物或农用的四轮车。

lemmas.def_en: a tight cluster of people or things

examples.en: He tied a secure knot at the end of the rope to prevent it from slipping.
examples.zh: 他在绳索末端打了一个牢固的结，以防其滑脱。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指绳结、人群、心头疙瘩或航速单位“节”，常用 tie a knot 搭配。

examples.en: She gently pulled the unknotted ribbon from the beautifully wrapped gift box.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地将解开的丝带从包装精美的礼盒上拉下来。

lemmas.def_en: make into knots; make knots out of

examples.en: Anxiety caused the muscles in his stomach to knot as he waited for the verdict.
examples.zh: 在等待判决时，焦虑使他的胃部肌肉一阵发紧。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指打结、纠结，也常作比喻表示腹部或肌肉因紧张而紧缩。

lemmas.def_en: become or cause to become undone by separating the fibers or threads of

examples.en: It took him several minutes to unknot the tangled headphone cables patiently.
examples.zh: 他耐心地花了数分钟才解开缠绕在一起的耳机线。

lemmas.def_en: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
lemmas.def_zh: 有结的, 多节的, 多瘤的, 棘手的

examples.en: The committee met to address the knotty problem of funding local infrastructure.
examples.zh: 委员会开会商讨有关地方基础设施资金这一棘手问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指绳线交错系紧的硬块或树木节疤，后引申为航海速度单位。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden and decisive change of government illegally or by force
lemmas.def_zh: 政变；出人意料的成功举动

examples.en: The military staged a sudden coup and seized control of the capital.
examples.zh: 军方发动了突然政变，控制了首都。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 military coup（军事政变）或 stage a coup；引申为“出人意料的成功举措”，末尾p不发音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语coup（打击），引申为政变或出乎意料的成功之举。

lemmas.def_en: get lost, as without warning or explanation

examples.en: The early morning mist vanished rapidly under the warmth of the rising sun.
examples.zh: 清晨的薄雾在初升太阳的暖意下迅速消散得无影无踪。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，强调突然或彻底消失，常与 into thin air 或 without a trace 连用。

lemmas.def_en: so as to disappear or approach zero

examples.en: The chances of surviving such an accident are vanishingly small without proper gear.
examples.zh: 没有适当的装备，从这种事故中生还的几率微乎其微。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 消失的；绝迹的；不复存在的
lemmas.def_en: having disappeared or ceased to exist
lemmas.usage_note: 前置定语，多用于书面语和文学描写中，修饰文明、岁月、传统等，如 a vanished world / empire。

examples.en: The archaeologists searched for relics of a long vanished civilization.
examples.zh: 考古学家寻找着一个早已湮灭的文明遗迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语evanescere（消散），核心意为“突然不见、消失”。

lemmas.def_en: cause a sharp or stinging pain or discomfort

examples.en: The harsh chemicals in the cleaning spray began to sting his bare hands.
examples.zh: 清洁喷雾中刺鼻的化学成分开始刺痛他裸露的手部。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指昆虫叮蜇或化学品等引起刺痛，也可指言语刺伤他人情绪。

lemmas.def_en: cause a sharp or stinging pain or discomfort
lemmas.def_zh: 叮咬；刺痛（sting的过去式/过去分词） (v.)

examples.en: Deeply stung by her sarcastic remarks, he walked out of the room without saying a word.
examples.zh: 被她讽刺的话语深深刺伤，他一言不发地走出了房间。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词 sting 的过去式或过去分词，常用于被动语态表示被昆虫蜇伤或心灵受创。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of pain; something as sudden and painful as being stung

examples.en: Applying a soothing ointment can quickly relieve the sharp sting of a wasp bite.
examples.zh: 涂抹舒缓软膏可以迅速缓解被黄蜂蜇后的剧烈刺痛感。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指蜇伤的伤口、痛感或警方设计的卧底缉捕行动（sting operation）。

lemmas.def_en: a cocktail made of made of creme de menthe and brandy

examples.en: The bee left its sharp stinger embedded deep within her swollen thumb.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂将它尖锐的蜇针深深扎进了她肿胀的大拇指里。

lemmas.def_en: without a sting

examples.en: Many gardeners prefer keeping stingless bees because they are completely safe around children.
examples.zh: 许多园丁更喜欢饲养无刺蜂，因为它们在儿童身边十分安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原始词，核心意为“用尖锐物刺入并引起剧痛”。

lemmas.def_en: devoid of any qualifications or disguise or adornment
lemmas.def_zh: 严酷的；极明显的；赤裸的

examples.en: The report presents a stark picture of the severe economic crisis facing the region.
examples.zh: 该报告展现了该地区所面临的严峻经济危机的真实图景。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指对比鲜明刺目的、毫无修饰的或现实严酷的，常修饰 contrast, reality。

lemmas.def_en: in a stark manner
lemmas.def_zh: 完全, 分明地, 赤裸裸地

examples.en: The dark modern building contrasted starkly with the historic houses surrounding it.
examples.zh: 这座深色现代建筑与周围的历史古宅形成了鲜明对比。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being complete or utter or extreme
lemmas.def_zh: 严厉；质朴无华；严酷；明显（stark的名词形式）

examples.en: The starkness of the winter landscape was softened by the gentle falling snow.
examples.zh: 冬日景色的凄凉荒芜被飘落的柔和白雪所冲淡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语stearc（僵硬、严酷），引申指对比极鲜明或现实赤裸残酷。

lemmas.def_en: the position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape

examples.en: The Supreme Court's ruling was a landmark in civil rights history.
examples.zh: 最高法院的这项裁决是民权史上的一个里程碑。

lemmas.usage_note: 指地标建筑，亦常作定语修饰重大转折事件，如 landmark decision（里程碑式裁决）或 landmark case。

family_guide.root_logic: 由land（土地）+ mark（标记）复合而成，指界标，引申为重大里程碑。

lemmas.def_en: short-legged flightless birds of cold southern especially Antarctic regions having webbed feet and wings modified as flippers

examples.en: A lone penguin waddled across the icy shore.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的企鹅在冰冻的岸边摇摇摆摆地走着。

lemmas.usage_note: 具体名词表企鹅，为可数名词；日常搭配有 Emperor penguin（帝企鹅）及 a colony of penguins。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不明（或源自威尔士语“白头”pen gwyn），专指生活在南半球的企鹅。

lemmas.def_en: a conventional or formulaic conception or image
lemmas.def_zh: 铅版, 陈规, 老套

examples.en: The commercial was criticized for reinforcing outdated gender stereotypes.
examples.zh: 该广告因加深了过时的性别刻板印象而受到批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指对特定群体的刻板印象，多含贬义；常见搭配有 gender/cultural stereotype、reinforce/shatter a stereotype。

lemmas.def_en: treat or classify according to a mental stereotype
lemmas.def_zh: 使用铅版, 把...印制成盲文, 套用老套, 使一成不变

examples.en: Children should not be stereotyped as either sporty or academic based on their gender.
examples.zh: 不应仅仅根据性别就将孩子模式化地归为运动型或学术型。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态，表示把某人模式化或套用老套标签，常用结构为 stereotype somebody as something。

lemmas.def_en: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
lemmas.def_zh: 典型的; 带有成见的

examples.en: The movie relies on stereotypical characters rather than exploring original and realistic personalities.
examples.zh: 这部电影依赖于刻板的人物形象，而不是探索原创且真实的人格。

lemmas.def_en: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality

examples.en: He exhibited stereotypic behavior, pacing back and forth along the same path repeatedly.
examples.zh: 他表现出刻板的行为，沿着同一条路线反复来回踱步。

lemmas.def_en: in a stereotypical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 带有成见地(stereotype的副词形式)

examples.en: He does not act stereotypically masculine, often expressing his emotions quite openly.
examples.zh: 他并不像传统成见中那样充满男子气概，经常十分坦率地表达情感。

family_guide.root_logic: stereo-（固定、立体的）+ type（印模），原指铅字版，引申为思维上的刻板印象。

lemmas.def_en: meat from a domestic hog or pig

examples.en: Roast pork with apples is a classic Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 烤猪肉配苹果是经典的周日晚餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 指猪肉时为不可数名词（对比可数 pig）；美式政治俚语中可代指 pork barrel（地方利益拨款）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语porc（猪），特指供食用的“猪肉”。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the Arctic

examples.en: An arctic cold front swept across the northern plains.
examples.zh: 一股极地冷锋横扫了北部平原。

lemmas.usage_note: 指北极的或极寒的，首字母大写指北极地区；常搭配 Arctic Ocean、arctic conditions（严寒天气）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语arktikos（大熊星座的），因大熊座在北方，引申指北极的或极寒的。

lemmas.def_en: made from residue of grapes or apples after pressing

examples.en: The distillery uses grape marc to produce a strong traditional spirit.
examples.zh: 这家酿酒厂用葡萄渣酿造一种烈性传统烈酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性名词，专指酿酒榨汁后残留的葡萄渣，或由果渣蒸馏成的烈酒，多见于葡萄酒专业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语marc（残渣、酒糟），特指压榨水果（尤指葡萄）后剩下的渣滓或渣酿白兰地。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Cannabis; a coarse bushy annual with palmate leaves and clusters of small green flowers; yields tough fibers and narcotic drugs

examples.en: Several states have moved to legalize cannabis for medicinal use.
examples.zh: 已有几个州推进将药用大麻合法化。

lemmas.usage_note: 大麻的植物学与法律正式术语，不可数；常与 legalise/possess cannabis 或 medical cannabis 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语kannabis（大麻），植物学及法律常用术语。

lemmas.def_en: by that means or because of that

examples.en: He signed the contract, thereby committing himself to three years of service.
examples.zh: 他签署了合同，从而承诺服役三年。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面副词，常接现在分词表结果（如 thereby doing sth），意为“借此/从而”，不可单独连接分句。

family_guide.root_logic: there（那）+ by（通过），合意为“从而，借此”，表示因果关系。

lemmas.def_en: make a subtraction

examples.en: The company will automatically deduct income tax from your monthly salary.
examples.zh: 公司会自动从你的月薪中扣除个人所得税。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在计算总额时扣除或减去一部分，常用于财务、税务等商务语境，常见搭配为 deduct something from something。

lemmas.def_en: reason by deduction; establish by deduction

examples.en: From the muddy footprints near the window, detectives managed to deduce the suspect's height.
examples.zh: 侦探们根据窗户附近的泥泞脚印推断出了嫌疑人的身高。

lemmas.def_en: a reduction in the gross amount on which a tax is calculated; reduces taxes by the percentage fixed for the taxpayer's income bracket
lemmas.def_zh: 减除, 扣除, 减除额, 推论

examples.en: After a careful deduction based on the clues, she solved the mystery quickly.
examples.zh: 根据线索进行仔细推导后，她迅速解开了这个谜团。

lemmas.def_en: (taxes) an amount that can be deducted (especially for the purposes of calculating income tax)

examples.en: You must pay a five-hundred-dollar deductible before your car insurance covers the damage.
examples.zh: 在车险赔付损失之前，你必须先支付五百美元的免赔额。

lemmas.def_en: relating to logical deduction

examples.en: deductive reasoning

lemmas.def_en: capable of being deduced
not allowable as a deduction

examples.en: Personal living expenses are strictly nondeductible on your annual federal income tax return.
examples.zh: 个人生活开支在年度联邦所得税申报中严格属于不可扣除项。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀de-（向下、去除）+ duct（引导），原指“带走”，引申为金额等在计算中扣除。
family_guide.core_distinction: deduct指从总量中减去（金额、分数等）；deduce指通过逻辑推理得出结论。

lemmas.def_en: deficient in magnitude; barely perceptible; lacking clarity or brightness or loudness etc
lemmas.def_zh: 模糊的, 微弱的, 无力的

examples.en: There was a faint smell of lavender lingering in the empty bedroom.
examples.zh: 空荡荡的卧室里残留着一丝淡淡的薰衣草香味。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰光线、声音、气味或希望时表示微弱、隐约的，修饰人时常与 feel 连用表示头晕乏力，如 faint smell/smile。

lemmas.def_en: pass out from weakness, physical or emotional distress due to a loss of blood supply to the brain

examples.en: Several soldiers fainted from the intense heat during the long military parade.
examples.zh: 在漫长的阅兵式中，几名士兵因酷热而昏倒。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指因虚弱、惊吓或缺氧等短暂失去知觉晕厥，常见搭配有 faint from hunger/heat。

lemmas.def_en: to a faint degree or weakly perceived
lemmas.def_zh: 微弱地, 模糊地, 朦胧地

examples.en: The aroma of fresh coffee faintly drifted from the kitchen into the bedroom.
examples.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气从厨房隐隐约约飘进了卧室。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of faintness and of being ready to swoon
lemmas.def_zh: 微弱, 衰弱, 模糊

examples.en: A sudden wave of faintness came over her, forcing her to sit down immediately.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的眩晕感袭来，迫使她立刻坐了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语feint（软弱无力、假装），引申为微弱的或身体因缺氧而昏晕。

lemmas.def_en: usually paved outdoor area adjoining a residence
lemmas.def_zh: 阶地, 梯田, 房屋之平顶, 阳台, 沿岸防地, 露台

examples.en: Guests can enjoy breakfast in the morning on the open terrace overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 客人早晨可以在俯瞰大海的露天露台上享用早餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 指房屋外平整的露台、连排房屋或山坡梯田，常见搭配有 rooftop terrace、rice terrace、have drinks on the terrace。

lemmas.def_en: provide (a house) with a terrace
lemmas.def_zh: 使成梯田, 使成有平台屋顶

examples.en: Local farmers terraced the steep hillsides to prevent soil erosion and cultivate crops.
examples.zh: 当地农民把陡峭的山坡改造成梯田，以防止水土流失并耕种作物。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将陡峭的山坡或土地修筑改造成阶梯状梯田，多用于农业或地理语境，常用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语terra（土地），指地面的平阶结构，如露台、梯田或排屋。

lemmas.def_en: enter uninvited

examples.en: I am sorry to intrude on your family dinner, but we have an urgent situation at the office.
examples.zh: 很抱歉打扰你们的家庭晚餐，但办公室有紧急情况。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，指闯入私人空间或干扰事务，多带冒犯意味，常见搭配为 intrude on/upon/into someone's privacy。

lemmas.def_en: any entry into an area not previously occupied

examples.en: She considered the constant noise from next door a serious intrusion on her privacy.
examples.zh: 她认为隔壁持续不断的噪音严重侵犯了她的隐私。

lemmas.def_en: someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission
lemmas.def_zh: 侵入者, 干扰者, 妨碍者

examples.en: The home security alarm went off when an unknown intruder stepped into the yard.
examples.zh: 当一名不明身份的入侵者踏入院子时，家庭安全警报响了。

lemmas.def_en: aggressiveness as evidenced by intruding; by advancing yourself or your ideas without invitation

examples.en: The intrusiveness of modern digital advertising often annoys users seeking simple information online.
examples.zh: 现代数字广告的侵扰性常常惹恼那些只在网上寻找简单信息的用户。

lemmas.def_en: tending to intrude (especially upon privacy)

examples.en: He felt uncomfortable answering what seemed like an unnecessarily intrusive question about his finances.
examples.zh: 面对关于他财务状况的这种看似过分探听隐私的问题，他感到很不适。

lemmas.def_en: not interfering or meddling

examples.en: The background music was soft and unintrusive, allowing everyone to converse comfortably.
examples.zh: 背景音乐轻柔而不具侵扰感，让每个人都能舒适地交谈。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（向内）+ trude（推、挤），本义为强行硬挤进来，引申为入侵、打扰。

lemmas.def_en: reduce the level of land, as by erosion

examples.en: Unlike traditional plastics, this bio-based material degrades within six months under sunlight.
examples.zh: 与传统塑料不同，这种生物基材料在阳光下六个月内即可降解。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物表示贬低人格或降低品质；亦可作不及物或及物表示自然降解或退化，如 degrade naturally/the environment。

lemmas.def_en: changing to a lower state (a less respected state)

examples.en: Overgrazing has led to severe land degradation in the western regions of the country.
examples.zh: 过度放牧导致该国西部地区严重的土地退化。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，用于生态环境退化、恶化或受屈辱的状态，常见搭配为 environmental/soil degradation、face degradation。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（向下）+ grade（阶梯、级别），核心为降低品级或破坏原有结构。
family_guide.core_distinction: degrade 侧重于降低身份、品质或自然降解；degradation 是其动作或降解状态的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: emerge from the eggs

examples.en: The rebels secretly hatched a plot to overthrow the corrupt government.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子暗中策划了一个推翻腐败政府的阴谋。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指禽鸟鱼虫破壳孵化（及物/不及物），也常引申为密谋、策划阴谋或计划，如 hatch a plot/scheme/plan。

lemmas.def_en: not yet emerged from an egg
lemmas.def_zh: 未孵化的, 未充分孵化的, (喻)(阴谋)未准备就绪的, 没实现的

examples.en: The mother bird remained on the nest to protect the unhatched eggs from predators.
examples.zh: 鸟妈妈留在巢中，保护尚未孵化的鸟蛋免受捕食者的伤害。

lemmas.def_en: a place where eggs are hatched under artificial conditions (especially fish eggs)

examples.en: Thousands of young salmon are carefully raised at the state fish hatchery before release.
examples.zh: 数以千计的幼年鲑鱼在州立鱼类孵化场被悉心饲养，随后才被放流。

family_guide.root_logic: 中古英语词汇，本义指幼雏破壳而出，后引申出暗中策划、策划阴谋之意。

lemmas.def_en: an expression of lack of respect

examples.en: The student showed blatant disrespect towards the teacher by rolling his eyes in class.
examples.zh: 那个学生在课堂上翻白眼，公然表现出对老师的不敬。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指轻慢、不敬的态度或行为，常与介词 to 或 toward 连用，搭配如 show/treat with disrespect、no disrespect to...

lemmas.def_en: exhibiting lack of respect; rude and discourteous

examples.en: It is extremely disrespectful to interrupt others while they are expressing their opinions.
examples.zh: 在别人发表意见时打断对方是极其无礼的。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰言行或态度无礼、不敬，正式或日常均适用，常用结构为 be disrespectful to/towards somebody。

lemmas.def_en: show a lack of respect for

examples.en: He felt that his colleagues disrespected his opinions simply because he was the youngest member.
examples.zh: 他觉得同事们仅仅因为他是最年轻的成员就轻视他的意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指对某人或其信仰、规则不尊重或怠慢，语气较直接，常搭配 disrespect someone's authority/wishes。

lemmas.def_en: in a disrespectful manner

examples.en: The student spoke disrespectfully to the teacher and was asked to leave the room.
examples.zh: 那个学生对老师说话很不礼貌，被要求离开教室。

family_guide.root_logic: 否定前缀 dis-（不）+ respect（尊重），核心即缺乏尊重。

lemmas.def_en: cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of

examples.en: The manager humiliated the new employee by harshly scolding him in front of the entire team.
examples.zh: 经理在全团队面前严厉斥责新员工，让他当众颜面扫地。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，强调在公开场合使某人颜面扫地或尊严受挫，常见搭配有 humiliate someone publicly/in front of others。

lemmas.def_en: state of disgrace or loss of self-respect

examples.en: She endured the humiliation of failing the driving test three times before finally passing.
examples.zh: 她忍受了三次驾考不及格的尴尬屈辱，最终才通过考试。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示屈辱、蒙羞的状态或导致屈辱的事件，常见搭配为 suffer/endure humiliation、the humiliation of defeat。

lemmas.def_en: in a humiliating manner

examples.en: The team lost humiliatingly in the finals, failing to score even a single point.
examples.zh: 该队在决赛中屈辱地惨败，甚至一分未得。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人蒙羞的；屈辱的；难堪的
lemmas.def_en: making you feel very embarrassed, ashamed, or foolish
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰事件、经历、失败或条款，如 a humiliating defeat / confession。

examples.en: The national team suffered a humiliating defeat in the opening match.
examples.zh: 国家队在首场比赛中遭遇了令人蒙羞的惨败。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 humilis（低下的，与 humus 地面同源），把人踩在地上以使其丧失尊严。
family_guide.core_distinction: humiliate 为动词表施加羞辱；humiliation 为名词表羞辱或难堪的状态。

lemmas.def_en: existing as an essential constituent or characteristic
lemmas.def_zh: 固有的；内在的；生来就有的

examples.en: Stress is an inherent part of working in emergency medical services.
examples.zh: 高压是从事急诊医疗工作所固有的一部分。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，表示事物内部本来就具有、不可分割的属性，常与介词 in 连用，如 inherent risk/flaw/weakness。

lemmas.def_en: in an inherent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 内在地, 生来地, 固有地

examples.en: Rock climbing is inherently dangerous, even when proper safety gear is used.
examples.zh: 即使使用了适当的安全装备，攀岩运动在本质上也是危险的。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，用来修饰形容词或动词，意为本质上、先天具有地，常见搭配有 inherently dangerous/unstable/flawed。

lemmas.def_en: be inherent in something

examples.en: Fundamental human rights inhere in every individual from the moment of birth.
examples.zh: 基本人权从每个人出生的那一刻起便固有存在。

lemmas.def_en: the state of inhering; the state of being a fixed characteristic

examples.en: the inherence of polysemy in human language

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（在内）+ here（粘附），指天生粘附在内部的、与生俱来的特质。

lemmas.def_en: not carefully or expertly made
lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙的；天然的；简陋的；粗俗的

examples.en: The archaeological team managed to build a crude shelter using fallen branches and mud.
examples.zh: 考古队用断枝和泥土搭建了一座简陋的庇护所。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰原材料、估算或举止，常见搭配如 crude oil（原油）、crude estimate，多含未经提炼或粗糙之意。

lemmas.def_en: in a crude or unrefined manner
lemmas.def_zh: 照自然状态, 未成熟地, 粗杂地

examples.en: The temporary shelter was crudely constructed from scraps of wood and plastic sheets.
examples.zh: 这个临时避难所是用废弃木材和塑料布粗糙搭建而成的。

lemmas.def_en: a wild or unrefined state
lemmas.def_zh: 天然的状态, 未成熟, 生硬

examples.en: Critics noted the crudeness of his early paintings, which lacked technical refinement.
examples.zh: 评论家指出了他早期画作的粗陋之处，缺乏技艺上的打磨。

lemmas.def_en: a wild or unrefined state
lemmas.def_zh: 简陋, 粗糙, 不成熟状态

examples.en: Despite its visual crudity, the early video game captivated players around the world.
examples.zh: 尽管画面简陋，这款早期的电子游戏还是吸引了全世界的玩家。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 crudus（生的、未处理的），引申为粗糙的、天然未加工的或粗俗的。

lemmas.def_en: a person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another

examples.en: The foreign minister met with his French counterpart to discuss trade relations.
examples.zh: 外交部长与法国外长会面，探讨双边贸易关系。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指职能相当的人或功能相当的物，如 foreign counterpart（外长/同行），中式英语易漏定冠词或所属格。

family_guide.root_logic: counter（相对的、对应的）+ part（部分），指处于相对位置、职能或属性完全对等的人或物。

lemmas.def_en: someone who attacks in search of booty

examples.en: Lions are apex predators that play a crucial role in maintaining ecosystem balance.
examples.zh: 狮子是顶级捕食者，在维持生态平衡中起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学指“捕食性动物”（apex predator）；社会新闻中常比喻指“侵害弱小者”，如 sexual predator（性侵犯）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praeda（捕获物），词根表示掠夺，指通过捕食或剥削他人获取利益的主体。

lemmas.def_en: hold back to a later time

examples.en: The committee decided to postpone the vote until all members could review the revised proposal.
examples.zh: 委员会决定将表决推迟到所有成员审阅完修订提案之后。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，后接名词或动名词，常用结构为 postpone doing sth 或 postpone until/to，多用于正式语境。

lemmas.def_en: time during which some action is awaited

examples.en: The bad weather led to the postponement of the outdoor championship until next weekend.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气导致室外锦标赛延期至下周末举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 post-（向后）+ pone（放置），字面为“往后放”，即推迟。

lemmas.def_en: attempt by employing effort

examples.en: We must constantly strive for excellence in everything we do.
examples.zh: 我们在做任何事时都必须不断追求卓越。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常见搭配 strive for excellence/success 或 strive to do，过去式多用 strove。

lemmas.def_en: attempt by employing effort

examples.en: She strove hard to balance her demanding career with family life.
examples.zh: 她努力在繁重的事业与家庭生活之间寻求平衡。

lemmas.def_en: attempt by employing effort

examples.en: We have always striven to provide the best service to our clients.
examples.zh: 我们一直致力于为客户提供最优质的服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 estriver（争吵、抗争），演化为朝着目标竭尽全力地拼搏抗争。

lemmas.def_en: something that is regarded as a chance event

examples.en: She spent two dollars and won a million in the national lottery.
examples.zh: 她花了八块钱，在国家彩票中赢得了一百万。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 win the lottery 或 play/enter the lottery，比喻义表示“全凭运气的不可控之事”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 lot（抽签、分配命运），指通过抽签随机决定归属的博彩机制。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect

examples.en: Despite the harsh criticism, she handled the situation with remarkable grace and dignity.
examples.zh: 尽管遭受严厉指责，她仍表现出非凡的从容与尊严。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调人的自尊、体面或威严，高频搭配有 maintain/keep one's dignity、with dignity。

lemmas.def_zh: 增威严, 使高贵, 故作显贵
lemmas.def_en: confer dignity or honor upon

examples.en: I will not dignify those absurd rumors by giving them a public response.
examples.zh: 我绝不会公开回应那些荒谬的谣言，以免抬高它们的身价。

lemmas.def_zh: 不庄严的, 无尊严的
lemmas.def_en: lacking dignity

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dignus（有价值的、配得上的），指人内在的尊贵、庄严与尊严。

lemmas.def_en: an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented

examples.en: He rarely drinks hard liquor, preferring wine or beer instead.
examples.zh: 他很少喝烈酒，更喜欢葡萄酒或啤酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语中特指蒸馏烈酒（如威士忌、伏特加），不包含啤酒或葡萄酒，常搭配 hard liquor。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 liquere（流动、呈液体状态），专指经过蒸馏的烈性酒精液体。

lemmas.def_en: any large and important church

examples.en: The wedding took place in a medieval cathedral.
examples.zh: 婚礼在一座中世纪的大教堂举行。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指设有主教座位的“大教堂”，规模和等级通常高于普通教堂（church），为可数名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 主教的座位, 主教的教区, 权威人士的地位
lemmas.def_en: a throne that is the official chair of a bishop

examples.en: The bishop stood before the historic cathedra to deliver his annual Christmas sermon.
examples.zh: 主教站在具有历史意义的主教宝座前，发表一年一度的圣诞布道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kathedra（主教的宝座），专指设有主教座位的总教堂和大教堂。

lemmas.def_en: the protruding part of the lower jaw
lemmas.def_zh: n. 下巴；v. 用下巴触碰；做引体向上

examples.en: He rested his chin in his hand and stared out the window in deep thought.
examples.zh: 他用手托着下巴，望着窗外陷入沉思。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指下巴；习语 keep one's chin up 表示“振作起来”，take it on the chin 意为“坦然承受逆境”。

lemmas.def_en: raise oneself while hanging from one's hands until one's chin is level with the support bar
lemmas.def_zh: n. 下巴；v. 用下巴触碰；做引体向上

examples.en: The recruit could barely chin himself five times during the physical fitness test.
examples.zh: 在体能测试中，这名新兵勉强能做五次引体向上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用及物或不及物动词，在健身语境中常与 oneself 连用，表示做引体向上（将下巴挂过单杠）。

lemmas.def_en: having a receding chin

examples.en: He played the role of a weak, chinless bureaucrat in the drama.
examples.zh: 他在剧中扮演了一个软弱、缺乏决断力的官僚。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自日耳曼语族核心词，本义为下巴，引申指靠下巴支撑的动作。

lemmas.def_en: try to prevent; show opposition to

examples.en: High ticket prices tend to discourage young people from attending classical concerts.
examples.zh: 高昂的票价往往会打消年轻人去听古典音乐会的念头。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常见搭配为 discourage sb from doing sth（劝阻/阻止某人做某事），亦可作“使泄气”。

lemmas.def_en: the feeling of despair in the face of obstacles
lemmas.def_zh: 使泄气, 使气馁, 使沮丧, 使丧失信心, 使失去信心, 阻拦, 劝阻, 留难

examples.en: Despite repeated failures, he never showed the slightest hint of discouragement.
examples.zh: 尽管屡次失败，他从未流露出丝毫气馁之色。

lemmas.def_en: in a discouraging manner
lemmas.def_zh: 使人气馁地, 阻止地

examples.en: The initial sales figures were discouragingly low for the new product line.
examples.zh: 新产品线的初期销售数据低得令人沮丧。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 灰心的；泄气的；沮丧的
lemmas.def_en: having lost confidence, enthusiasm, or hope
lemmas.usage_note: 主语为人，描述个体的情绪状态，常用搭配为 feel discouraged about / by sth。

examples.en: Don't get discouraged by early failures; persistence is key.
examples.zh: 不要因为早期的失败而灰心，坚持才是关键。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；令人消沉的
lemmas.def_en: causing someone to lose confidence, hope, or enthusiasm
lemmas.usage_note: 主语为事物，指消息、结果或趋势等令人气馁，如 discouraging news / results。

examples.en: The preliminary test results were discouraging, but the scientists refused to give up.
examples.zh: 初步测试结果令人沮丧，但科学家们拒绝放弃。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（剥夺、反对）+ courage（勇气），核心意为“使人失去勇气或信心”。

lemmas.def_en: an elementary particle with negative charge

examples.en: An atom consists of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.
examples.zh: 原子由原子核及环绕其运动的电子组成。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理与化学专业词汇，常搭配 electron microscope（电子显微镜）或 free electron。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 elektron（琥珀），因摩擦琥珀可产生静电而得名，专指带负电的基本粒子。

lemmas.def_en: the supreme commander of a fleet; ranks above a vice admiral and below a fleet admiral
lemmas.def_zh: n. 海军上将；舰队司令

examples.en: The admiral commanded the entire fleet during the exercise.
examples.zh: 海军上将在演习期间统领整个舰队。

lemmas.usage_note: 海军高级将领头衔，常作称谓大写置于姓名前（如 Admiral Smith），亦可作普通可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自阿拉伯语 amir-al-（指挥官、长官），经罗曼语演变为海军高级统帅称谓。

lemmas.def_en: do without or cease to hold or adhere to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 放弃（权利、要求等）；免除

examples.en: The university agreed to waive the application fee for low-income students.
examples.zh: 该大学同意为低收入学生免除申请费。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，属于正式或法律用语，常搭配 rights（权利）、fees（费用）或 penalties（罚款），表示自愿放弃或免除。

lemmas.def_en: a formal written statement of relinquishment

examples.en: Participants must sign a liability waiver before taking part in the extreme sport.
examples.zh: 参与者在参加该极限运动前必须签署一份免责声明书。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指弃权行为或书面弃权声明，高频搭配为 sign a waiver（签署免责声明）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，本义为“放弃所有权或遗弃”，引申为放弃合法权利或免除规则。
family_guide.core_distinction: waive 为动词，表示主动放弃权利；waiver 为名词，指放弃权利的行为或书面弃权声明。

lemmas.def_en: someone who practices a learned profession
lemmas.def_zh: n. 执业医生；从业者；实践者

examples.en: She consulted a general practitioner about her persistent cough.
examples.zh: 她因持续咳嗽咨询了一位全科医生。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指医学或法律从业者，高频搭配 general practitioner（全科医生，简称 GP），属正式用语。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 practice（实践、从业），加后缀 -itioner 指专门从事某项专业业务的人员。

lemmas.def_en: one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper

examples.en: A heavy snowstorm caused several massive tree limbs to crash onto the power lines.
examples.zh: 一场暴风雪导致数根巨大的树枝砸断了供电线路。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指人体/动物的四肢或树的大分枝；习语 go out on a limb 表示“冒风险提出不同意见”。

lemmas.def_en: having no limbs
lemmas.def_zh: 无肢的, 无枝叉的, 无翼的

examples.en: Snakes are typical examples of limbless reptiles that move by slithering.
examples.zh: 蛇是通过滑行移动的无肢爬行动物的典型代表。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语词根，指人或动物的身体分支（四肢），引申为树木的大枝干。

lemmas.def_en: take away possessions from someone

examples.en: Working continuous night shifts can deprive employees of adequate restorative sleep.
examples.zh: 持续值夜班会剥夺员工获得充分恢复性睡眠的机会。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，核心搭配为 deprive sb/sth of sth，常用于法律、心理或生理语境，表示剥夺或使丧失必要之物。

lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme poverty
lemmas.def_zh: 剥夺, 剥夺官职, 免职

examples.en: Chronic sleep deprivation can severely impair your cognitive functions and overall health.
examples.zh: 长期睡眠剥夺会严重损害认知功能和整体健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（表完全、剥离）+ prive（单独、私人，同 private），核心意为“强行剥夺某人的拥有物”。

lemmas.def_en: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth

examples.en: The tabloid was accused of exaggerating the scandal to boost its daily circulation.
examples.zh: 这家小报被指责蓄意夸大丑闻以提高其每日发行量。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，表示夸大事实、症状或重要性，常用搭配如 exaggerate the importance/impact of sth。

lemmas.def_en: extravagant exaggeration
lemmas.def_zh: 夸张, 夸大的事物, 夸大之词

examples.en: It is no exaggeration to say that this book changed my life.
examples.zh: 毫不夸张地说，这本书彻底改变了我的人生。

lemmas.def_en: in an exaggerated manner

examples.en: He sighed exaggeratedly to show everyone how completely exhausted he felt.
examples.zh: 他夸张地叹了口气，向所有人表明自己有多疲惫。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 夸大的；夸张的；过分的
lemmas.def_en: regarded or represented as larger, better, or worse than in reality
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰言辞、肢体动作、报道或情绪反应，如 exaggerated claims / gestures。

examples.en: Reports of the company's financial crisis were grossly exaggerated.
examples.zh: 关于该公司财务危机的报道被严重夸大了。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁前缀 ex-（出）+ agger（堆积），本义为“向上堆积得过高”，引申为言辞上的夸大。

lemmas.def_en: lacking or deprived of the sense of hearing wholly or in part
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 聋的，听不见的；不愿听的

examples.en: The manager turned a deaf ear to the reasonable complaints raised by the staff.
examples.zh: 经理对员工提出的合理解释与投诉充耳不闻。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指生理失聪或充耳不闻，搭配如 fall on deaf ears（未被理睬）、turn a deaf ear to（不愿听取）。

lemmas.def_en: people who have severe hearing impairments

examples.en: The organization works to create more accessible public services for the deaf.
examples.zh: 该组织致力于为聋人群体创造更多无障碍的公共服务。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常以 the deaf 形式出现，作集合名词，指“聋人整体”，谓语动词通常用复数形式。

lemmas.def_en: partial or complete loss of hearing

examples.en: Her progressive deafness forced her to learn sign language at a young age.
examples.zh: 逐渐加重的耳聋迫使她在很小的时候就学习手语。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自日耳曼原始词根，本义为听觉迟钝或缺失，常引申为充耳不闻。

lemmas.def_en: not affected by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 未醉的；严肃的；清醒的；v. （使）清醒；（使）变得严肃

examples.en: He stayed completely sober throughout the evening so he could drive everyone home safely.
examples.zh: 他整个晚上都滴酒未沾，以便能安全开车送大家回家。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人的神智或态度，搭配 sober assessment（清醒评估）或 stay sober（保持清醒），语气客观庄重。

lemmas.def_en: cause to become sober
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 未醉的；严肃的；清醒的；v. （使）清醒；（使）变得严肃

examples.en: A cup of strong black coffee helped sober him up before the crucial morning meeting.
examples.zh: 一杯浓黑咖啡帮助他在关键的早会前清醒了过来。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作及物或不及物动词，常与 up 连用表示醒酒，引申为（使）冷静，多用于口语与叙述体。

lemmas.def_en: in a grave and sober manner

examples.en: The detective spoke soberly about the serious consequences of the recent incident.
examples.zh: 侦探严肃地谈论了最近这起事件的严重后果。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being sober and not intoxicated by alcohol

examples.en: Her calm soberness helped steady the entire team during the sudden crisis.
examples.zh: 在突发危机中，她的冷静沉着帮助稳住了整个团队。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sobrius（不醉酒的、节制的），引申指神志清醒、严肃沉稳的状态。

lemmas.def_en: a purposeful or industrious undertaking (especially one that requires effort or boldness)

examples.en: Despite their greatest endeavor, the rescue team could not reach the stranded climbers before nightfall.
examples.zh: 尽管搜救队竭尽全力，仍未能在天黑前赶到受困登山者身边。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面用语，常作可数或不可数名词，常见搭配包括 make an endeavor 或 scientific endeavor。

lemmas.def_en: attempt by employing effort

examples.en: The university will endeavor to provide equal academic opportunities for all incoming students.
examples.zh: 该大学将竭尽全力为所有新生提供平等的学术机会。

lemmas.usage_note: 高度正式的动词，几乎固定接动词不定式 endeavor to do sth.，表示竭力追求或尝试实现目标。

lemmas.def_en: attempt by employing effort
lemmas.def_zh: 努力, 力图, 尽力

examples.en: We will endeavour to resolve your customer complaint as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 我们将尽力尽快解决您的客户投诉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语词组 en devoir（尽职责、尽本分），演化为尽全力努力做某事。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is voluntarily absent from home or country

examples.en: The dissident writer spent more than two decades in exile before finally returning home.
examples.zh: 这位异见作家在流亡海外二十余年后，终于重返故土。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指流放状态（不可数）也可指流亡者（可数），常与介词 in 或 into 搭配，如 live in exile。

lemmas.def_en: expel from a country

examples.en: The defeated monarch was exiled to a remote island far away from the mainland.
examples.zh: 战败的君主被流放到了一个远离大陆的偏远岛屿上。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be exiled from... to...，多见于历史、政治或法律相关文本。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a period of exile (especially the exile of the Jews known as the Babylonian Captivity)

examples.en: The poet wrote poignant verses reflecting his painful exilic experience abroad.
examples.zh: 这位诗人写下了凄美的诗篇，反映他在海外流亡的痛苦经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exsilium（被逐出本土），表示被驱逐出国门或远离家乡的处境。

lemmas.def_en: works for an expert to learn a trade

examples.en: The young carpenter began his career as an apprentice in a renowned furniture workshop.
examples.zh: 这位年轻木匠起初是在一家著名的家具作坊里当学徒。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指特定行当的学徒或入门新手，常搭配 carpenter's apprentice 或 trade apprentice。

lemmas.def_en: the position of apprentice

examples.en: He secured a four-year apprenticeship with a renowned local electrical company.
examples.zh: 他在当地一家著名的电气公司获得了为期四年的学徒期。

lemmas.def_en: be or work as an apprentice

examples.en: At the age of fourteen, he was apprenticed to a local blacksmith to learn the trade.
examples.zh: 十四岁时，他被送给当地一位铁匠当学徒以学习手艺。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于被动语态 be apprenticed to sb.，表示“使拜师学艺”，属较为正式的历史或职场用语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 apprehendere（领悟、抓住），经法语引申为“为了学会技艺而跟随师傅的初学者”。

lemmas.def_en: a legislative act is referred for final approval to a popular vote by the electorate
lemmas.def_zh: n. 全民公投，公民表决

examples.en: The government decided to hold a referendum on the proposed constitutional reforms.
examples.zh: 政府决定就拟议的宪法改革举行全民公投。

lemmas.usage_note: 政治术语，常与动词连用 hold/call a referendum on sth（就某事举行全民公投），复数可用 -dums 或 -da。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 referre（带回、汇报），字面指将某事交由全体选民裁决。

lemmas.def_en: take revenge for a perceived wrong

examples.en: The prince swore an oath to avenge his father's murder and reclaim the stolen throne.
examples.zh: 王子立下重誓，要为父亲被谋杀一事报仇，并夺回被篡夺的王位。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，宾语常为受害者或所受冤仇，如 avenge oneself / avenge one's death，具文学色彩。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes vengeance

examples.en: The masked avenger sought justice for the innocent victims of the corrupt regime.
examples.zh: 这位蒙面复仇者试图为腐败政权的无辜受害者讨回公道。

lemmas.def_en: for which vengeance has not been taken
lemmas.def_zh: 未得报仇的,未得雪耻的

examples.en: He swore that his brother's brutal murder would not remain unavenged.
examples.zh: 他发誓绝不会让他兄弟惨遭杀害的罪行得不到昭雪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vindicare（维护正义、复仇），强调替他人伸张正义或惩恶报仇。

lemmas.def_en: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极其怪诞的，奇异的

examples.en: She suddenly broke into laughter for no apparent reason, which was truly bizarre behavior.
examples.zh: 她毫无征兆地突然大笑起来，这举动着实怪诞离奇。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 behavior、situation、appearance 等，强调异乎寻常的怪异荒诞，语体生动且适用广泛。

lemmas.def_en: strikingly out of the ordinary
lemmas.def_zh: 稀奇古怪的性质或状态

examples.en: The utter bizarreness of the modern art installation left many visitors completely puzzled.
examples.zh: 这件现代艺术装置的离奇古怪让许多参观者感到困惑不解。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自巴斯克语或意大利语，最初指胡子威严，后演化为古怪、不可思议。

lemmas.def_en: fine powdery foodstuff obtained by grinding and sifting the meal of a cereal grain

examples.en: Mix the flour and yeast thoroughly in a large bowl before pouring in any warm water.
examples.zh: 在倒入温水之前，先在大碗中将面粉和酵母彻底混合均匀。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，多用于烹饪或烘焙语境，常见搭配如 plain flour（中筋面粉）或 wheat flour。

lemmas.def_en: cover with flour

examples.en: Lightly flour the wooden rolling pin to prevent the soft pastry dough from sticking.
examples.zh: 在木制擀面杖上薄薄撒一层面粉，以防止柔软的面团粘连。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，主要用于烹饪指南，常搭配 flour the surface / board，表示在操作表面洒薄粉防粘。

lemmas.def_en: resembling flour in fine powdery texture
lemmas.def_zh: 面粉的, 撒满粉的, 粉状的

examples.en: She dusted the dough with floury hands before rolling it out thin.
examples.zh: 她在把面团擀薄之前，用沾满面粉的双手拍了拍面团。

family_guide.root_logic: 与 flower 同源，原指谷物磨粉后提取的最精细、“精华”的部分。

lemmas.def_en: the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)

examples.en: The government completely failed to grasp the magnitude of the economic crisis in its early stages.
examples.zh: 政府在初期完全没有意识到这场经济危机的巨大严重性。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，常与 of 连用表示规模之大，也特指地震震级，常见搭配 an earthquake of magnitude 7.0。

lemmas.def_zh: 扩大, 放大率, 放大的复制品
lemmas.def_en: the act of expanding something in apparent size

examples.en: Under high magnification, the microscope revealed tiny bacteria invisible to the naked eye.
examples.zh: 在高倍放大下，显微镜展现出了肉眼看不见的微小细菌。

lemmas.def_en: a scientific instrument that magnifies an image

lemmas.def_zh: 放大, 扩大, 赞美, 夸大；有放大能力
lemmas.def_en: increase in size, volume or significance

examples.en: This powerful microscope can magnify the cell structure up to a thousand times clearly.
examples.zh: 这台高倍显微镜能将细胞结构清晰地放大一千倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 magnus（大），表示规模、重要性或震级的巨大程度。

lemmas.def_en: walk unsteadily
lemmas.def_zh: v. 绊倒；蹒跚；结结巴巴地说

examples.en: He stumbled in the dark and knocked over the bedside lamp.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗中绊了一下，撞翻了床头灯。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 across/on/upon 搭配表示偶然发现，stumble over/through 意为结结巴巴地说，比 trip 更强调步履不稳。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼具动作演变，模拟失足磕绊或动作磕磕绊绊的声响与状态。

lemmas.def_en: an ignorant or foolish person
lemmas.def_zh: n. 愚蠢的错误；笨蛋；(俚)乳房 /

examples.en: I made a terrible boob by addressing the CEO by the wrong surname during the presentation.
examples.zh: 我在汇报演讲时叫错了首席执行官的姓氏，犯了个极其低级的错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式口语中指低级错误，常搭配 make a boob；亦在美式俚语中作身体部位称谓，属非正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: commit a faux pas or a fault or make a serious mistake

examples.en: The accountant admitted that he had boobed when calculating the quarterly tax return.
examples.zh: 这位会计承认自己在核算季度报税单时犯了糊涂。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式非正式不及物动词，表示搞砸或犯蠢，常在日常交谈中用于认错或调侃失误。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声俚语，既可代指愚蠢的错误/笨蛋，也可指女性乳房。

lemmas.def_en: complete and without restriction or qualification; sometimes used informally as intensifiers

examples.en: Winning the difficult championship was a result of sheer determination and relentless practice.
examples.zh: 赢得这项艰难的锦标赛，完全是出于纯粹的坚定决心与不懈苦练。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语表“纯粹的”（如 sheer luck），或形容悬崖地势“垂直陡峭的”，语意强烈且具书面色彩。

lemmas.def_en: turn sharply; change direction abruptly

examples.en: The speeding speedboat suddenly sheered away to avoid colliding head-on with the coral reef.
examples.zh: 疾驰的快艇突然紧急转向偏航，以避免迎头撞上珊瑚礁。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，搭配 away 或 off，多指船只、车辆等骤然偏航或急拐弯，多见于航海及动态描写。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心义为“纯粹、清澈”，引申为完全的、陡峭的或急转弯。

lemmas.def_en: awaiting conclusion or confirmation
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 待定的，悬而未决的 /

examples.en: The deal is subject to regulatory approval and remains pending.
examples.zh: 该交易仍需监管机构批准，目前处于悬而未决状态。

lemmas.usage_note: 后置或作表语表示悬而未决的，常搭 pending approval/investigation；亦可充当介词表示等待……期间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pendere（悬挂），引申为悬而未决、等待发生。

lemmas.def_en: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given

examples.en: Rules have changed, and we must adjust our plans accordingly.
examples.zh: 规则已经发生改变，我们必须相应地调整计划。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于句首或句尾，表示相应地照办（act accordingly）或书面语中表因果结论（因此，于是）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 accord（一致），加后缀形成副词，表示“照着相应地”或“因此”。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy precious metallic element; grey-white and resistant to corroding; occurs in some nickel and copper ores and is also found native in some deposits

examples.en: Her latest pop album went platinum within two weeks of its release.
examples.zh: 她的最新流行专辑在发行两周内就达到了白金唱片销量。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词指贵金属铂，商业中常作定语修饰 card/record，表示白金级或唱片销量达白金级别。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西班牙语 platina（小银），因色泽似银而得名，实为珍贵的贵金属铂。

lemmas.def_en: a person with great powers and abilities
lemmas.def_zh: n. 超人，具有超常能力的人

examples.en: No manager is a superman who can solve every corporate crisis alone.
examples.zh: 没有哪位经理是能独自化解公司所有危机的超人。

lemmas.usage_note: 小写时泛指能力超群的超人，非正式语境常含轻微夸张或调侃，需注意复数形式为 supermen。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 super-（超）+ man（人），意指具备超越凡人能力的存在。

lemmas.def_en: the act of passing something along from one person or group to another
lemmas.def_zh: 驿马, 替班, 中继, 接力

examples.en: Our team won the gold medal in the 4x100-meter relay.
examples.zh: 我们队赢得了4×100米接力赛的金牌。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指“接力赛”或“中继设备”，高频搭配如 relay race、satellite relay，多用于体育与通信语境。

lemmas.def_en: pass along
lemmas.def_zh: 分程传递, 转播, 使接替；接力传送, 转播

examples.en: Please relay the updated schedule to all committee members.
examples.zh: 请将更新后的日程安排转达给所有委员会成员。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“转述（信息）”或“转播（信号）”，常接双宾语或与 to 连用，多见于正式汇报及媒体报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指打猎时替换疲惫猎犬的新犬，后引申为接替、接力传递。

lemmas.def_en: provide with power and authority
lemmas.def_zh: 使穿衣服, 授予；穿衣服, 归属

examples.en: Executive power is vested in the President by the constitution.
examples.zh: 宪法赋予总统行政权力。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律及正式语境中指“授予（权力/财产）”，常见结构为 vest in sb 或 vest sb with sth。

lemmas.def_en: a man's sleeveless garment worn underneath a coat

examples.en: He wore a three-piece suit complete with a silk vest.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套三件套西装，配有一件丝绸马甲。

lemmas.usage_note: 美语中指西装“马甲”，英语中多指贴身“汗衫/背心”，常与 safety、bulletproof 连用。

lemmas.def_en: gown (especially ceremonial garments) worn by the clergy
lemmas.def_zh: 衣服, 衣裳, 礼服, 法衣, 祭服

examples.en: The priest wore an ornate vestment during the annual Christmas Eve midnight service.
examples.zh: 在一年一度的平安夜子夜弥撒中，神父身着华丽的法衣。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣服, 衣裳, 覆盖物
lemmas.def_en: something that covers or cloaks like a garment

examples.en: The mountain peaks were hidden beneath a thick, pristine vesture of winter snow.
examples.zh: 山峰被一层厚厚而洁白的冬雪覆盖物遮蔽住了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vestis（衣服），由“穿衣”引申至赋予合法权力或财产，现代亦指特定背心衣物。

lemmas.def_en: according to or characteristic of a casebook or textbook; typical

examples.en: The pilot performed a textbook emergency landing on the water.
examples.zh: 飞行员在水面上完成了一次教科书式的紧急迫降。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词表示“典型的、教科书式的、符合规范的”，多作定语修饰 example、case 等词。

lemmas.def_en: a book prepared for use in schools or colleges

examples.en: Students are required to buy the latest edition of the textbook.
examples.zh: 学生们需要购买该教科书的最新版本。

lemmas.usage_note: 指教学使用的“教科书、课本”，可数名词，常与 school、standard 等连用，口语及书面均常用。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 text（正文）+ book（书）构成，引申指符合规范、堪称典范的。

lemmas.def_en: a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits
lemmas.def_zh: 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车

examples.en: We hailed a cab outside the theater to catch our train.
examples.zh: 我们在剧院外拦了一辆出租车以赶火车。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指“出租汽车”，也可指机车或卡车的驾驶室，常用短语有 take a cab、hail a cab。

lemmas.def_en: ride in a taxicab

examples.en: It was raining heavily, so we decided to cab it home.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大，所以我们决定打车回家。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语表达，指“乘出租车出行”，多与 to、home 连用，直接作不及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: cabriolet（双轮单马轻便车）的缩写，现代主要指出租车或大型车辆驾驶室。

lemmas.def_en: stretch (the neck) so as to see better
lemmas.def_zh: 伸颈, 起重机起吊；伸颈看, 迟疑

examples.en: Spectators had to crane their necks to catch a glimpse of the passing parade.
examples.zh: 观众们不得不伸长脖子，才能看一眼路过的游行队伍。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于搭配 crane one's neck（伸长脖子看），不及物时常接 over 或 forward，生动形容努力张望的动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自鹤类长颈的特征，引申为如鹤一般伸长脖子看，或指起重机。

lemmas.def_en: not moving or operating freely
lemmas.def_zh: 坚硬的, 严厉的, 呆板的, 生硬的, 刚强的, 强烈的, 粘的, 稠的, 艰难的

examples.en: My neck felt stiff after working at the computer all day.
examples.zh: 在电脑前工作了一整天后，我的脖子感到很僵硬。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容物体“僵硬的”或人“肌肉酸痛的”，亦可表示“激烈的、严厉的”，搭配 stiff competition。

lemmas.def_en: an ordinary man
lemmas.def_zh: 死尸, 醉鬼, 钞票

examples.en: The detectives found a stiff lying in the abandoned alley.
examples.zh: 侦探们在废弃的小巷里发现了一具死尸。

lemmas.usage_note: 俚语或粗俗语体，指“死尸”；也可指“无趣拘谨的人”，常用于口语或犯罪小说语境中。

lemmas.def_en: the physical property of being inflexible and hard to bend
lemmas.def_zh: 坚硬, 呆板, 刻板

examples.en: Gentle stretching exercises can effectively reduce muscle stiffness after an intense physical workout.
examples.zh: 温和的拉伸运动可以有效减轻剧烈锻炼后的肌肉僵硬。

lemmas.def_en: in a stiff manner
lemmas.def_zh: 呆板地, 顽固地, 僵硬地

examples.en: The nervous candidate sat stiffly in the chair while answering the interviewer's tough questions.
examples.zh: 这位紧张的应聘者僵硬地坐在椅子上，回答面试官棘手的问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 原始印欧语根表“僵硬、紧绷”，引申为死板、艰难或口语中的死尸、吝啬鬼。

lemmas.def_en: a large or extra supply of something
lemmas.def_zh: 贮水池, 贮藏处, 贮备, 水库

examples.en: Heavy rainfall throughout the spring season completely filled the city's main water reservoir.
examples.zh: 整个春季的强降雨使该市的主要蓄水库彻底蓄满了水。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为水库，比喻义常与 of 连用表示“储备”，如 a reservoir of talent/knowledge（人才/知识储备）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 réserver（保留、储存），指蓄积水或资源的场所与载体。

lemmas.def_en: a person who comes from a foreign country; someone who does not owe allegiance to your country

examples.en: As a foreigner living abroad, she quickly learned to adapt to the local customs.
examples.zh: 作为一名旅居国外的外国人，她很快学会了适应当地的习俗。

lemmas.usage_note: 指外国国籍者；在某些跨文化语境中略显疏离，正式公文或礼貌表达中常被 international visitor 等替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 foreign（外国的，源自拉丁语 foris '在门外'）+ -er（人）。

lemmas.def_en: the process of gradually becoming inferior

examples.en: Regular brushing helps prevent tooth decay and gum disease.
examples.zh: 定期刷牙有助于预防蛀牙和牙龈疾病。

lemmas.usage_note: 指生物的“腐败、蛀蚀”或社会的“衰退”，常与 tooth、urban 搭配，属于正式书面语体。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has fallen into a decadent state (morally or artistically)

examples.en: The young poet was often labeled a decadent by critics for his rebellious lifestyle.
examples.zh: 这位年轻诗人因其叛逆的生活方式常被评论家贴上颓废派的标签。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being degenerate in mental or moral qualities

examples.en: Historians often view lavish royal banquets as signs of imperial decadence.
examples.zh: 历史学家常常将奢靡的皇室宴会视为帝国走向颓废的象征。

lemmas.def_en: lose a stored charge, magnetic flux, or current

examples.en: Fallen leaves decay quickly in the warm, humid forest.
examples.zh: 落叶在温暖潮湿的森林中迅速腐烂。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指“腐烂、衰败”，多用于自然分解过程或抽象实体的逐步弱化。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（向下、离开）+ cadere（落下），核心意为结构衰败、逐渐毁坏。

lemmas.def_en: look at thoughtfully; observe deep in thought
lemmas.def_zh: 注视, 沉思, 盘算；冥思苦想

examples.en: She sat quietly on the bench to contemplate her next career move.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐在长椅上，深思着下一步的职业打算。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指“深思、盘算”，后接名词或动名词，不能接不定式，属于书面语及学术语体。

lemmas.def_en: a long and thoughtful observation
lemmas.def_zh: 注视, 沉思, 盘算

examples.en: She spent several quiet hours in deep contemplation before making her final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，她静静地深思了几个小时。

lemmas.def_en: a person devoted to the contemplative life

examples.en: Monks and other contemplatives often devote their entire lives to solitary prayer and meditation.
examples.zh: 僧侣和其他沉思冥想者通常将一生奉献给独处的祈祷与冥想。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语，原指古罗马占卜官在神圣观测区域（templum）内仔细观察天象，引申为深入沉思或打算。

lemmas.def_en: cause (a liquid) to spatter about, especially with force
lemmas.def_zh: 溅湿, 溅开, 飞溅；溅, 泼, 使溅起水, 洒, 使成斑驳状

examples.en: The speeding car splashed dirty water all over my trousers.
examples.zh: 疾驰的汽车把泥水溅得我满裤子都是。

lemmas.usage_note: 指液体“泼洒、飞溅”，可及物也可不及物，常见搭配 splash water on、splash across。

lemmas.def_zh: 装饰表面的, 铺张的, 夸示的, 华美的, 显眼的
lemmas.def_en: intended to attract notice and impress others

examples.en: His ostentatious gold watch immediately drew irritated glances from everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他那块招摇的金表立刻引来了会议室里所有人的反感。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by water flying about haphazardly
lemmas.def_zh: 容易溅开的, 泥泞的, 遍布斑点的

examples.en: The tech giant launched its new flagship phone with a very splashy marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头通过一场格外引人注目的营销活动推出了新款旗舰手机。

lemmas.def_en: not ostentatious

examples.en: his unostentatious office
unostentatious elegance

lemmas.def_zh: 铺张地, 招摇地, 炫耀地
lemmas.def_en: with ostentation; in an ostentatious manner

examples.en: Mr Khrushchev ostentatiously wooed and embraced Castro at the U.N. general assembly

lemmas.def_zh: 虚饰, 虚有其表, 卖弄
lemmas.def_en: a gaudy outward display

examples.en: His lavish mansion was viewed by neighbors as an unnecessary display of ostentation.
examples.zh: 邻居们认为他那座奢华的豪宅纯粹是毫无必要的炫耀。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟液体猛烈拍击、飞溅的声音及动作。

lemmas.def_en: the highest or uppermost side of anything
lemmas.def_zh: 上侧, 上段, 上部

examples.en: The main upside of working from home is avoiding the stressful daily morning commute.
examples.zh: 居家办公的主要好处就是可以避开每天早晨令人烦躁的通勤。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 the upside of sth 或 on the upside，指不利局面的“积极面/好处”，反义词为 downside。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 up（上）+ side（面/侧）组合，指正面、积极的一面或潜在上升空间。

lemmas.def_en: any of various juicy fruit of the genus Vitis with green or purple skins; grow in clusters

examples.en: They harvested sweet grapes from the vineyard to make wine.
examples.zh: 他们从葡萄园里采摘甜葡萄来酿酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 指水果“葡萄”，可数名词，常以复数形式出现，高频搭配 sour grapes（酸葡萄心理）。

lemmas.def_en: having a taste like that of grapes

examples.en: This sweet dessert wine has a delightfully fresh and grapey flavor throughout.
examples.zh: 这款甜点酒从头到尾都带有一种令人愉悦的新鲜葡萄风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指用于采摘葡萄的“钩子”，后借代指成串结挂的葡萄果实。

lemmas.def_en: a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)
lemmas.def_zh: 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物

examples.en: She took some coins out of her purse to pay the driver.
examples.zh: 她从钱包里拿出几枚硬币付给司机。

lemmas.usage_note: 美语中指女士“手提包”，英语中指小巧的“零钱包”，也引申指“财力、资金”，通用度高。

lemmas.def_en: contract one's lips into a rounded shape

examples.en: The teacher pursed her lips in disapproval when the boy spoke.
examples.zh: 当那个男孩说话时，老师不以为然地抿起了嘴唇。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指“撅嘴、抿嘴”（表达不满、怀疑或沉思），常用搭配 purse one's lips。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 bursa（皮革、钱包），名作动引申为把嘴唇收缩成小钱袋口状。

lemmas.def_en: one of several resident of a dwelling (especially someone confined to a prison or hospital)

examples.en: The prison guard conducted a headcount of every inmate before lights out.
examples.zh: 熄灯前，狱警对每位囚犯进行了清点。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，尤指监狱中的“囚犯”（同 prisoner）或精神病院的“住院病人”，常与 of 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 in（在内）+ mate（同伴）组合，原指住在一起的人，现特指监狱囚犯或疗养院住院者。

lemmas.def_en: occurring without interruption; chiefly restricted to what recurs regularly or frequently in a prolonged and closely spaced series

examples.en: The project was delayed by continual technical problems.
examples.zh: 该项目因频繁出现的技术问题而延误。

lemmas.def_en: seemingly without interruption

examples.en: She continually checked her phone for updates.
examples.zh: 她不停地查看手机看是否有最新消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 continuare（使连接），核心指动作反复发生或接连不断。
family_guide.core_distinction: continual 指频频发生、断断续续的重复；continuous 指时间或空间上毫无间断的连续。

lemmas.def_en: a cavity or space in something

examples.en: We set up our small camp in a sheltered hollow between two hills.
examples.zh: 我们在两座小山之间避风的山谷洼地里扎了营。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实, 无诚意, 伪善
lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being open or truthful; deceitful or hypocritical
the state of being hollow: having an empty space within
lemmas.def_zh: 凹窝, 空旷, 空虚

examples.en: Despite his professional success, he felt an overwhelming hollowness in his personal life.
examples.zh: 尽管事业成功，他却在个人生活中感受到了巨大的空虚。

lemmas.def_en: remove the inner part or the core of

examples.en: We set up our small camp in a sheltered hollow between two hills.
examples.zh: 我们在两座小山之间避风的山谷洼地里扎了营。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实的, 无诚意的, 伪善的
lemmas.def_en: lacking sincerity

examples.en: His insincere apology failed to convince anyone in the crowded meeting room.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的会议室里，他虚情假意的道歉未能说服任何人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实地, 无诚意地
lemmas.def_en: without sincerity

examples.en: she congratulated him somewhat insincerely

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 holh（洞、穴），核心意象为内部空虚或凹陷。

lemmas.def_en: an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something

examples.en: The detective wore a clever disguise to blend in with the street crowd.
examples.zh: 便衣刑警巧妙乔装，以便混入街头人群中。

lemmas.def_en: make unrecognizable

examples.en: The detective wore a clever disguise to blend in with the street crowd.
examples.zh: 便衣刑警巧妙乔装，以便混入街头人群中。

lemmas.def_en: plain to see
lemmas.def_zh: 无伪装的, 不戴假面具的, 公开的

examples.en: She looked at the rival with undisguised contempt during the intense debate.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，她毫不掩饰地对对手投去轻蔑的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（改变/除去）+ 古法语 guise（外表/风俗），核心指改变外表以隐瞒真实身份。

lemmas.def_en: spin,wind, or twist together
lemmas.def_zh: 结带子, 饰以花边；系带子

examples.en: He sat on the bench to lace his running shoes before the marathon.
examples.zh: 他在长椅上坐下，在马拉松开跑前系好了跑鞋鞋带。

lemmas.def_en: undo the ties of

examples.en: She sat down on the porch to unlace her muddy hiking boots after the trek.
examples.zh: 徒步归来后，她坐在门廊上解开了沾满泥巴的登山靴鞋带。

lemmas.def_en: a workman who laces shoes or footballs or books (during binding)

examples.en: The technician used a mechanical belt lacer to quickly repair the conveyor system.
examples.zh: 技术人员使用机械接带机迅速修好了传送带系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 丝带的, 花边的, 花边状的
lemmas.def_en: made of or resembling lace

examples.en: She wore a beautiful dress adorned with delicate lacy patterns along the sleeves.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件袖口装饰着精美花边图案的漂亮连衣裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 laqueus（绳套、陷阱），引申为编织花边或用带子系紧。

lemmas.def_en: remove from memory or existence

examples.en: She tried to erase the painful memories of that bitter winter from her mind.
examples.zh: 她试图从脑海中抹去那个寒冬的痛苦回忆。

lemmas.def_en: an implement used to erase something

examples.en: The student used a soft eraser to remove the pencil marks from his drawing.
examples.zh: 那个学生用软橡皮擦掉了图画上的铅笔痕迹。

lemmas.def_en: a correction made by erasing

examples.en: Repeated erasure of the pencil marks eventually tore a hole in the manuscript.
examples.zh: 反复擦除铅笔痕迹最终把手稿蹭破了一个洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 e-（向外）+ 拉丁语 radere（刮），字面意为“刮掉”，引申为擦除、消除。

lemmas.def_en: annual or biennial grass having erect flower spikes and light brown grains

examples.en: The golden wheat fields swayed gently beneath the warm summer afternoon breeze.
examples.zh: 金黄色的麦田在温暖的夏日午后微风中轻轻摇曳。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为作物或粮食通常为不可数名词，常见搭配 wheat flour（小麦粉）、whole wheat（全麦），勿随意加复数。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，与 white（白）同源，因磨出的面粉呈白色而得名。

lemmas.def_en: declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
lemmas.def_zh: 宣布, 公告, 宣言, 表明, 赞扬

examples.en: The mayor will proclaim next Monday as an official city holiday for everyone.
examples.zh: 市长将宣布下周一为全市法定假日。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣言, 公布, 布告, 公告
lemmas.def_en: a formal public statement

examples.en: The mayor issued an official proclamation declaring next week as local environmental week.
examples.zh: 市长发布了一份官方公告，宣布下周为当地环境周。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（向前、公开）+ claim（呼喊），即向大众公开呼喊宣布。

lemmas.def_en: relating to a recently developed fashion or style

examples.en: He installed an unofficial mod that greatly improved the classic game's visual textures.
examples.zh: 他安装了一个非官方模组，大大改善了这款老游戏的画面材质。

lemmas.def_en: a British teenager or young adult in the 1960s; noted for their clothes consciousness and opposition to the rockers
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 模型, 修改, 调制, 模

examples.en: He installed an unofficial mod that greatly improved the classic game's visual textures.
examples.zh: 他安装了一个非官方模组，大大改善了这款老游戏的画面材质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 modern（现代的）的口语截断形式，特指20世纪60年代英国兴起的摩斯族时尚文化。

lemmas.def_en: any liliaceous plant of the genus Lilium having showy pendulous flowers

examples.en: A single white lily bloomed gracefully in the center of the garden pond.
examples.zh: 一朵白百合在花园水池中央优雅地绽放。

lemmas.usage_note: 百合花，可数名词；常用比喻搭配 lily-white（纯白的、无可挑剔的），习语 paint the lily 表示画蛇添足。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 lilium，象征纯洁典雅的百合花。

lemmas.def_en: a distinctive characteristic or attribute

examples.en: The famous company moved quickly to trademark its new brand logo globally.
examples.zh: 这家知名公司迅速采取行动，在全球范围内将其新品牌标志注册为商标。

lemmas.def_en: mark with a brand or trademark

examples.en: The famous company moved quickly to trademark its new brand logo globally.
examples.zh: 这家知名公司迅速采取行动，在全球范围内将其新品牌标志注册为商标。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 trade（商业/贸易）+ mark（标记）组合而成，核心指商业标识。

lemmas.def_en: any of various large food and game fishes of northern waters; usually migrate from salt to fresh water to spawn

examples.en: Every autumn, millions of wild salmon swim upstream to their native spawning grounds.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，数百万条野生鲑鱼都会逆流而上回到出生产卵地。

lemmas.usage_note: 指鱼单复数同形（three salmon）；作食材时为不可数；常搭配 smoked salmon（烟熏三文鱼），注意 l 不发音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 salmo，可能与 salire（跃起）有关，指这种鱼溯流而上跳跃的习性。

lemmas.def_en: expect, believe, or suppose
lemmas.def_zh: 计算, 总计, 估计, 认为, 猜想；数, 计算, 估计, 依赖, 料想

examples.en: I reckon we will arrive at the destination before the sun sets today.
examples.zh: 我估计我们今天能在太阳落山前到达目的地。

lemmas.def_en: an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)
lemmas.def_zh: 计算者, 清算人, 计算手册

examples.en: The clerk used a printed ready reckoner to calculate the tax payments instantly.
examples.zh: 店员使用现成的速算手册迅速计算出了应缴税额。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 recenian（清点、安排），核心意象为计算，引申为估算、认为。

lemmas.def_en: lift and reset in another soil or situation
lemmas.def_zh: 使移居, 移植, 使迁移；移居, 耐移植

examples.en: Surgeons successfully transplanted a healthy kidney into the elderly patient yesterday.
examples.zh: 外科医生昨天成功为这位老年患者移植了一个健康的肾脏。

lemmas.def_en: an operation moving an organ from one organism (the donor) to another (the recipient)
lemmas.def_zh: 移植, 移民, 移植术

examples.en: Organ transplantation requires advanced surgical techniques and careful post-operative care.
examples.zh: 器官移植需要先进的手术技术和细致的术后护理。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 trans-（转移）+ plant（种植），字面为移植植物，后引申为器官移植。

lemmas.def_en: a period of time spent sleeping
lemmas.def_zh: 小睡, 稍睡, 细毛, 孤注一掷

examples.en: He usually takes a short nap after lunch to recharge his energy.
examples.zh: 他通常在午饭后小睡一会儿以恢复精力。

lemmas.def_en: garment consisting of a folded cloth drawn up between the legs and fastened at the waist; worn by infants to catch excrement

examples.en: She bought a pack of disposable nappies for her newborn baby.
examples.zh: 她为刚出生的婴儿买了一包一次性尿布。

lemmas.def_en: take a siesta
lemmas.def_zh: 小睡, 疏忽；使拉毛, 打盹度过, 预测...为获胜马

examples.en: He usually takes a short nap after lunch to recharge his energy.
examples.zh: 他通常在午饭后小睡一会儿以恢复精力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hnappian（打瞌睡），专指短时间的小睡。

lemmas.def_en: a person who carries a message

examples.en: Don't shoot the messenger; I'm just delivering the bad news.
examples.zh: 别迁怒于报信的人，我只是来传达坏消息的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指送信人或信使，名言 don't shoot the messenger 意为“不要怪罪报信的人”。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 message（信息），加表示人的后缀 -er，核心意为‘传递信息的人或物’。

lemmas.def_en: (football) the person who plays quarterback
